about: A cashier sale (rangka-apps pos_sale with promotions and loyalty) computed by the kernel's own compute path (kernel/internal/engine/pos_parity_test.go, which writes want with -update) and by engine.js prepare() (web/app/test/engine.test.js), which must agree: a paired device's totals are binding (contract 0058 §10). models is a snapshot of rangka-apps (tools/pos_parity_models.py keeps it in step); records are what the computes look up; each case is a new sale with the apps installed and the org's tax. records are as the kernel holds them; a paired device holds the data sets minus fields hidden from the cashier (e.g. promotion.code), so the counter takes the kernel's own preview (POST /compute) while online and refuses non-record checkout values (codes, points, deposit) offline: the cases with a shared code describe the online numbers.

fields.compute: promotion == '' || subtotal < promotion.min_spend || !promotion.active || promotion.valid_from > date || promotion.valid_until < date || (promotion.only_outlet != '' && promotion.only_outlet != outlet) || (promotion.code_mode == 'shared' && promo_code.trim().upperAscii() != promotion.code) ? 0 : (promotion.kind == 'bill_pct' ? (promotion.max_discount > 0 ? min(promotion.max_discount, round(subtotal * promotion.pct / 100)) : round(subtotal * promotion.pct / 100)) : (promotion.kind == 'bill_off' ? min(subtotal, promotion.amount_off) : 0))
fields.name: bill_promo_offer

fields.compute: gross_total - subtotal + discount_amount + bill_promo + member_discount + points_discount
fields.name: discount_total

fields.compute: tax.pkp ? round(grand_total * tax.ppn_rate * tax.dpp_num / (100 * tax.dpp_den + tax.ppn_rate * tax.dpp_num)) : 0
fields.name: ppn_in_sales

fields.compute: promotion == '' ? 0 : (promo_kind == 'pct' ? round(gross * promo_pct / 100) : (promo_kind == 'off' ? min(gross, round(stock_qty * promo_off)) : (promo_kind == 'buy_get' && promo_buy + promo_get > 0 ? min(gross, round(int(stock_qty / (promo_buy + promo_get)) * promo_get * item.rate)) : 0)))
fields.name: promo_discount

fields.compute: is_gift ? 0 : (promo_discount == 0 ? round(qty * rate * (100 - discount_pct) / 100) : round((gross - promo_discount) * (100 - discount_pct) / 100))
fields.name: amount
